in_hebrew.name: תַּבְבִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: derived from the Hebrew word טבב (tavav) meaning 'to be sharp' or 'to be swift', the name Tabby could be interpreted as 'swift one' or 'sharp one' in Hebrew

in_greek.name: Ταββη
in_greek.long_meaning: the name Tabby in Greek could be interpreted as 'she who gazes' or 'she who looks' based on the Greek word ταβω (tabō) meaning 'to gaze at' or 'to look at'

in_latin.name: Tabita
in_latin.long_meaning: the name Tabby in Latin could be interpreted as 'she who revives' or 'she who gives life' based on the Latin word tabita meaning 'small, little' and the Latin verb teneo meaning 'to hold' or 'to keep'
